question: What was the total trade value in 2015?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2015 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: Total trade value = sum of quantity x trade price
